LOW POLY BIRDS - AMERICAN ROBIN (FREE SAMPLE)
=============================================

One low-poly bird, hand-animated, with 20 animation clips.

Modelled and animated for the game Look to the Birds.


WHAT IS IN HERE

  GLB/        glTF binary. Godot, Blender, three.js, any glTF pipeline
  FBX/        Unity, Unreal, Maya, 3ds Max
  Blender/    the .blend sources, rigs and animation included
  Textures/   256x256 PNG, one per bird, loose so you can repaint them
  LICENSE.txt


BIRDS

  American Robin
    20 clips, 1,424 triangles, 53 bones, wing blend shape: yes

    A_Call_01, A_Call_02, A_Call_03, A_Flutter, A_Fly_01, A_Hop_01,
    A_Hop_02, A_Hop_03, A_Idle_01, A_Idle_02, A_Idle_03,
    A_PeckGround_01, A_PeckGround_02, A_PeckGround_03, A_Preen_01,
    A_Preen_02, A_Preen_03, A_ScratchGround_01, A_ScratchGround_02,
    A_ScratchGround_03


TECHNICAL NOTES

  - Clip names are the same across every bird in the collection
    (A_Idle_01, A_Fly_01, A_Preen_02 and so on), so you can swap
    species without rewiring your animation logic.
  - Every rig uses the same skeleton layout, 53 bones.
  - 1 of these birds carry a wing blend shape called
    "Wings_Folded", keyed per clip: 0 is spread, 1 is folded.
  - One 256x256 texture per bird and flat shading. No normal,
    roughness or metallic maps to hook up.
  - The birds stand with their feet on the origin.


If something is broken or missing, say so here:

  https://soltorchgames.itch.io/
